instruction.german: Read the text in Figure it out. Complete the rules in the grammar box with was or were.

parts:
Figure it out

My sporting hero is Pele. He was one of the best football players of the 20th century. But Pele wasn’t just a football player. He was also a musician and a writer. His books were about his life and, of course, they were about football.


Grammar | was / were

The past form of be is was / were.

• We use 1 with I, he, she and it.

In 1926, Gertrude Ederle 2 the first woman to swim from England to France.

• We use 3 with you, we and they.

Bobby and Jack Charlton 4 very successful football players.

• To form the negative, we use not (n’t).

I wasn’t good at sport when I was younger.

They weren’t interested in football when they were at school.
